sections.title: Added
items: Your own Explore post menus now include View insight, including posts opened from an Insight sheet or your Profile's published scans.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Notification-opened comment reply threads now include the same emoji reaction controls as regular Explore comments.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Overview interactions now wrap fully instead of truncating longer ecological interaction notes.

sections.title: Changed
items: Pro plan cards now match the current paywall value props for unlimited field scans, Pro AI vision, AI chat, multi-capture, Apple Watch logging, and expedition mode.

sections.title: Changed
items: Pro plan cards now use the intended launch prices and labels for Annual and the 7 Day Pass, even while App Store product metadata is settling.
AI chat now appears in the Pro paywall feature comparison table.

sections.title: Added
items: Scans now has a full filter sheet for sorting, category, dates, location, tags, naturalist details, photo quality, identification state, weather, season, and taxonomy.
The Scans filter sheet now includes an Explore posts filter for scans that have already been shared to Explore.
Scans filters now stack with search and sorting, with a visible active-filter count and a clear action that keeps the current search text.
The Scans and Collections active-filter badge is now red so it stands out from the blue filter button.

sections.title: Changed
items: Collections now starts with a taller full-width Featured scans collection that uses a daily rotating set of up to 24 scans from your library.
Favorites, Needs review, and Non-biological now appear as gallery-style artwork collection tiles.
Collections now has a Scans-style filter sheet with sorting plus User-created, Smart suggestions, and Built-in collection type filters.
Collection creation now lives in a blue plus button in the Collections toolbar, the unused Collections sort menu has been removed, and Needs review stays pinned instead of being hideable.

sections.title: Changed
items: Explore post shares now use clearer Merian copy before the public web preview link.
Explore post web links now open the matching native Explore post when Merian is installed.

sections.title: Improved
items: Species seasonality charts now use one unified month heatmap with represented totals, peak month detail, and a clearer unavailable state while buckets refresh.

sections.title: Added
items: Biological Insight sheets now open Field chat from the bottom toolbar as a dedicated sheet with one saved conversation per scan.
Add to collection now lives in the Insight header menu below field notes, keeping the bottom toolbar focused on sharing and chat.
Field chat answers now use richer private scan context, including observed traits, ecology metadata, review state, and capture-quality signals.
Field chat now supports offline read-only viewing, failed-send retry and edit, safety guidance headers, answer feedback, and append-only field-notes actions.
The Field chat toolbar button now has a subtle steady rainbow glow so the AI entry point is easier to notice without moving or restyling the native button label.
Field notes cards now show more of your notes before truncating longer entries.
Field chat summaries now use readable observation labels instead of internal scan IDs.
Field chat answer actions are now focused on icon-only copy and inline feedback, with summaries and feature feedback in the sheet options menu.
Field chat sheet feedback is now saved privately with the scan instead of being telemetry-only.
Field chat quick prompts now refresh with AI-generated, scan-specific follow-up ideas based on the saved observation and recent chat.
Field chat now checks scan availability before opening so scans owned by another signed-in account show a clear unavailable state instead of launching into a chat error.

sections.title: Added
items: Insight images now open into a full-screen, fit-centered carousel with swipe navigation, zoom, and reference attribution.
Species Dictionary reference galleries now open into the same full-screen image viewer.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Profile signed-out spacing below the sign-in buttons now matches the gap between the stat cards.
Describe suggestions now keep the bottom toolbar available after you tap a prompt chip.
The Describe add button now uses a secondary outline state when the input is empty and the filled active state once text is present.
Profile published-scan grids now keep rounded outer image corners on partial rows instead of exposing sharp edges.
The full-screen Insight image viewer now closes with a downward swipe.
Full-screen Insight images now stay vertically centered in the viewer.
Collections now has a little more top spacing so the first cards sit more comfortably below the Scans toolbar.
Explore Index Catalog scrolling now keeps the grouped gray background behind the full page instead of ending partway down the catalog.

entries.title: Dictionary, taxonomy tree, and layout updates

sections.title: Changed
items: Ask the Community search can now find GBIF-backed taxa that are not yet enriched in Merian's Dictionary.
Newly materialized Dictionary species can now hydrate habitat, lookalikes, and group tags in the background.
Merian's Community ID taxonomy and enrichment systems now have stronger backend monitoring for rollout health.
Merian can now safely seed bird taxonomy coverage in the background for future Dictionary completeness progress.
Smart Collection cards now use varied matching scan covers, except Recent finds, instead of always reusing the newest scan thumbnail.
Dog and cat scans can now show a likely breed, mix, coat pattern, or body type while Merian keeps the underlying species taxonomy unchanged.
The main camera tab bar now matches the Explore bottom navigation icon size, label size, and item spacing.
Identify requests now have organism filters for Plants, Birds, Insects, Fungi, Mammals, and Herps while keeping Yours near the start of the filter row.

Community request details now frame the starting name as Merian's AI identification with the stored scan model tier, an optional confidence pill, and collapsed reasoning, while the ID count lives with the Identifications section.
Explore Tree now opens in a top-down taxonomy layout instead of the earlier sideways orientation.
Explore Dictionary and Tree controls now provide haptic feedback on button actions.
Explore Tree now has All species and My scans filter pills so you can switch between Merian's public taxonomy and your scanned-species tree.
Explore Dictionary cards, rows, thumbnails, loading skeletons, and the featured Recently Added card now use the softer rounded corners and roomier image-first layout from Identify request surfaces.
Explore Dictionary Catalog now opens directly into the browse overview without a top-level search bar, while subcategory catalog pages keep their own search.
The Explore Dictionary Recently Added feature card now opens that species' dictionary page, while a separate Recently Added row opens the full newest species list.
Explore Dictionary previews now prefer promoted Merian community photos over external reference images when available.
Notifications settings now include a single action to turn off every Merian notification category at once.
Open Identify request cards and loading skeletons now hide AI-derived names and show only the scan image with a compact submitted-ID count overlay.
Guests can now choose a public profile picture, display name, and username before signing in, and those choices carry into Apple or Google sign-in.
Profile now starts with identity and stats, followed by published scans, the non-Pro plan card, persona progress, the scan heatmap, and achievements.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Publishing a resolved Ask the Community request now applies the owner-approved species consensus to the scan and prepares new GBIF-backed species for Dictionary enrichment.
Ask the Community requests now stay associated with your signed-in account after identity changes, so they remain visible under Yours.
Explore Dictionary Recently Added now shows the newest-entry count instead of matching the full All species total.
Insight sharing and Ask the community requests now recover when a local scan is missing its cloud scan row.
The Ask the community request sheet now keeps Send and Save in the sheet toolbar so create and edit requests use the same form style.
The proactive beta feedback survey now waits until the Insight sheet closes before appearing after your third scan.
Identify request cards now refresh their submitted-ID badge after you suggest, withdraw, or restore an ID from the request detail screen.
Existing Ask the community requests now show Edit and View actions in the Insight share flow, plus a Publish to Explore option with a visible review disclaimer.
Explore feed hashtag rows now scroll edge to edge without being clipped by card padding.
The Explore edit-post sheet now keeps its Save footer compact instead of expanding up the screen.
Explore Map now keeps the active selected waypoint above overlapping nearby waypoints.
Explore Map bottom controls now stay anchored near the tab bar when switching from Feed to Map.
Identify now returns from community request details without flashing the generic Explore title in the header.
Explore profile pages now load with skeleton placeholders instead of a simple spinner.
The Pro paywall hero carousel no longer clips the image glow into a hard top edge.
The Insight share sheet now uses the Identify artwork, updated Ask the Community action icons, and clearer helper and confirmation copy.
Explore Tree zoom controls no longer jump upward when selecting a taxonomy node.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore Map now has horizontal species-type filter pills for the current region.
The first filter pill opens a detailed filter sheet for selecting map species types.
Map filters now use backend category counts so visible clusters and discoveries match the active species filters.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore now has an Identify tab for Ask the Community identification requests.
Biological insights can request community help with optional notes and post-level location sharing.
The Community Suggest ID sheet now opens with AI-derived starting suggestions when available.
Identify now has Requests and Activity modes in the header, plus an All/Yours request filter.
Your own Community requests now have an options menu for editing the request note and location sharing.
Community requests from other explorers now have a report action in the options menu.
Community request detail images now extend into the top edge of the sheet, matching Insight image presentation.
Community requests now load with skeleton cards instead of a spinner.
Explore error states now use the same unavailable layout and Retry action style as Dictionary.
Community identification notifications now cover new IDs, resolved requests, and helped consensus outcomes, with a dedicated Profile push preference.
Ask the Community confirmations now include a View action that opens the new request directly.
When all identification candidates are rejected, Ask the Community is now offered as the next step.
Community request details include consensus status, an identification timeline, taxonomy search, disagreement prompts, and withdraw/restore actions.

sections.title: Changed
items: Community identification now uses versioned taxonomy, queued consensus processing, and verified Explore graduation behind the scenes.
Low-confidence Insight shares now default to asking Identify for help, while direct Explore publishing remains available behind a confirmation.
Resolved Identify requests now stay out of normal Explore until the owner explicitly publishes them.
Explore hashtag pills now use transparent backgrounds, gray borders, and blue text on feed cards, post detail pages, and the post composer.
The unused identification-review action has been removed from Insight and candidate review flows.
Community identification sheets now use icon close controls and a cleaner disagreement reason field.
Community identification timelines now hide internal consensus labels from user-facing copy.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore Dictionary now has a header control for switching between the Catalog and taxonomy Tree views.
The Explore bottom menu stays focused on Observations, Identify, and Dictionary while Feed/Map and Catalog/Tree live in header controls.
The Tree view now opens directly into the pan-and-zoom taxonomy canvas without its own search field or filled top heading background.
The Tree zoom and locate controls now use liquid-glass circular buttons.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Species Dictionary catalog and overview surfaces now filter out non-biological encyclopedia rows before they can appear as dictionary records.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Profiles with no scans now still show the empty contribution cells in the scan heatmap instead of a collapsed grid.

sections.title: Added
items: A one-time beta feedback survey now asks how Merian is working for testers after meaningful use.
You can also open the survey from Settings in the Resources section.
Survey responses are saved privately so the team can review polish, performance, bugs, and feature requests.
After submitting, the thank-you state resets after 24 hours so you can send fresh feedback again from Settings.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore now has bottom navigation for Observations, Identify, and Dictionary.
Observations now has a header control for switching between Feed and Map, with Feed first.

Dictionary opens with a Recently Added featured species card, a full-width Your Region map card when local entries are available, an All row, plus region rows for browsing local range metadata. Region browsing stays hidden when no region records are available.
Your Region can use already-granted location access for a better local match, while falling back to the device locale without a Dictionary-specific permission prompt.
Dictionary also includes custom graphic browse cards for broad groups like Plants, Birds, Insects, Fungi, Mammals, and Reptiles & Amphibians, with toolbar search available inside those species lists.

entries.title: Scan durability, reanalysis, and geoprivacy fixes

sections.title: Changed
items: Candidate review prompts now appear only for non-strong identifications or strong IDs with a competitive alternative, while stored candidates remain available for recovery and future review flows. The Needs review smart collection follows the same non-strong and competitive-alternative thresholds.
Biological scan images are now durable for Free and Pro users; Merian no longer auto-purges successful sighting evidence based on age or tier.
Species dictionary galleries can now include more published Merian photos while still requiring strong species confidence.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Non-biological corrections now explain what happened and start reanalysis instead of creating an unidentified biological scan with incorrect confidence, phantom reference media, or early Explore sharing.
Non-biological results now show the clearer title "Non-biological" instead of unresolved taxonomy placeholder text.
Correction reanalysis from the Non-biological collection remains available to free users while still following normal daily scan limits when submitted.
The reanalysis explanation no longer stays in the Describe text field as if it were user-entered notes.
Describe notes entered for the current reanalysis are now included with the submission and cleared from the input afterward.
Explore Map now shows only open-location discoveries, keeping obscured and private posts off the map.
Explore share and edit options now include per-post geoprivacy, so a post can be private, obscured, or explicitly open without changing the underlying scan default.

sections.title: Added
items: 7-day Pro passes now use verified RevenueCat purchases with a Merian-owned expiration window so access ends reliably after the pass period.

sections.title: Improved
items: The Pro paywall now has a richer visual flow with selectable plan cards, plan comparisons, member-supported context, and a persistent purchase button.
Restore purchases, redeem code, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use actions are easier to find from the paywall.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore comments now support @username mentions for post authors, visible thread participants, and people you follow.
Mentioned users can receive Explore activity notifications without turning the comment into a reply.

sections.title: Improved
items: The comment composer can suggest eligible handles as you type, and tapped mentions open that user's public Explore profile.
Notification settings now include an independent push toggle for Explore comment mentions.
Explore activity and comment mention push notifications now default on for new installs.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The comment mention push toggle now stays independent from the separate Explore activity push setting.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Needs review now follows the shared non-strong and competitive-alternative thresholds instead of including every scan with alternate candidates.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore sharing and editing now lets you choose which known common name appears on the community post.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Shared Explore posts now keep the selected common name instead of drifting to dictionary defaults.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Non-biological scans older than 30 days are now cleaned up locally when the app returns to the foreground or when you open the Non-biological collection.

sections.title: Added
items: Collections can now suggest useful groups from your scan library, including recent finds, places, review candidates, Explore posts, and common organism groups.
Smart collections update automatically from your library and can be hidden locally.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Private scans now hide location details across scan cards, sharing, achievements, and Messages share captions.
Open and obscured scans now restore location context at the expected precision.

entries.title: Explore post details and dictionary improvements

sections.title: Improved
items: Explore post details now keep deeper species education in the species dictionary, with a direct link from each post.
Reference images, observation context, and alternate common names are arranged more clearly around the post's AI explanation.
Species dictionary pages can now load for species you have not discovered yet.
Explore posts now use usernames on feed cards and post detail headers.
The changelog now shows dates without version labels while release versioning is still being finalized.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Similar species suggestions now load reliably in insight sheets.

sections.title: Improved
items: Species observation charts now show public totals, seasonality, and history more quickly on first load.
Detailed life-stage and sex buckets refresh in the background so slow public data does not block the whole chart.

entries.title: Custom profile pictures, metadata, and sharing improvements

sections.title: Added
items: A new Settings changelog collects selected release notes, feature notes, and in-progress work inside the app.
Native Messages and Photos share extension groundwork for sharing cached scan images, cards, descriptions, and queued image identification.
Logged-in users can upload custom public profile pictures, with Explore/Profile identity refresh.
AI-derived sex observation metadata on scan records, the Overview card, Supabase persistence, and Darwin Core exports.

sections.title: Improved
items: Field notes dictation startup feels steadier, and the loading spinner no longer shifts the button label.
Capture bottom controls stay visible after leaving Describe or canceling staged input.
Audio insight carousel swiping remains responsive when reference images load after the audio page is already visible.

sections.title: Added
items: Initial web app scaffold for public Explore share pages.
Public Terms, Privacy Policy, Community Guidelines, Privacy Choices, Support, and Legal hub pages for merian.earth.
An iOS-to-web theme bridge so Merian-opened web pages can follow your app theme preference.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Explore map count text now says exactly one visible item is one discovery in view.
Scan purge jobs no longer risk deleting durable public avatar images.
